item.name: Victoria Hand
steps: In episode 17, Hand suspects Coulson when HYDRA rises, then works with him to arrest Garrett.
In episode 17, Grant Ward kills Hand to free Garrett.
In season 7, in a changed 1983, a young Agent Hand shoots Garrett as he teleports in, then sees Deke take charge of S.H.I.E.L.D.
deceased_step: In episode 17, Grant Ward kills Hand to free Garrett.
next_step: In season 7, in a changed 1983, a young Agent Hand shoots Garrett as he teleports in, then sees Deke take charge of S.H.I.E.L.D.

item.name: Christine Palmer
steps: In episode 4, Christine dies in a car crash, and every attempt Strange makes to save her fails.
In episode 18, Strange Supreme gives his life to restore his universe, and Christine lives again.
deceased_step: In episode 4, Christine dies in a car crash, and every attempt Strange makes to save her fails.
next_step: In episode 18, Strange Supreme gives his life to restore his universe, and Christine lives again.

item.name: Cyclops
steps: Stryker brainwashes Cyclops into fighting Jean, and he loses her at Alkali Lake.
Grieving, Scott goes to Alkali Lake, where the returned Jean kills him.
In the new 2023 that Logan wakes to, Scott is alive at the school.
deceased_step: Grieving, Scott goes to Alkali Lake, where the returned Jean kills him.
next_step: In the new 2023 that Logan wakes to, Scott is alive at the school.

item.name: Jean Grey
steps: As her powers grow, Jean holds back the flood at Alkali Lake and is lost beneath the water.
Jean returns from Alkali Lake ruled by the Phoenix. She begs Logan to save her, and he kills her.
In the new 2023 that Logan wakes to, Jean is alive at the school.
deceased_step: Jean returns from Alkali Lake ruled by the Phoenix. She begs Logan to save her, and he kills her.
next_step: In the new 2023 that Logan wakes to, Jean is alive at the school.

item.name: Bishop
steps: In the dark 2023, Kitty sends Bishop's mind back in time to warn the team of Sentinel attacks. The final attack kills him.
When Logan changes history, Bishop's death is erased, though he is not seen in the new 2023.
deceased_step: In the dark 2023, Kitty sends Bishop's mind back in time to warn the team of Sentinel attacks. The final attack kills him.
next_step: When Logan changes history, Bishop's death is erased, though he is not seen in the new 2023.

item.name: Blink
steps: In the dark 2023, Blink's portals help the X-Men outrun the Sentinels, but the final attack kills her.
When Logan changes history, Blink's death is erased, though she is not seen in the new 2023.
deceased_step: In the dark 2023, Blink's portals help the X-Men outrun the Sentinels, but the final attack kills her.
next_step: When Logan changes history, Blink's death is erased, though she is not seen in the new 2023.

item.name: Roberto da Costa
steps: In the dark 2023, Sunspot fights the Sentinels beside the X-Men and dies in the final attack.
When Logan changes history, Sunspot's death is erased, though he is not seen in the new 2023.
deceased_step: In the dark 2023, Sunspot fights the Sentinels beside the X-Men and dies in the final attack.
next_step: When Logan changes history, Sunspot's death is erased, though he is not seen in the new 2023.

item.name: James Proudstar
steps: In the dark 2023, Warpath senses the Sentinels coming and dies in the final attack.
When Logan changes history, Warpath's death is erased, though he is not seen in the new 2023.
deceased_step: In the dark 2023, Warpath senses the Sentinels coming and dies in the final attack.
next_step: When Logan changes history, Warpath's death is erased, though he is not seen in the new 2023.

item.name: X-Force
steps: Deadpool forms X-Force to stop Cable, and its members die one by one on their very first jump.
Shatterstar is alive again at Wade's birthday party, but the rest of the team is still gone.
deceased_step: Deadpool forms X-Force to stop Cable, and its members die one by one on their very first jump.
next_step: Shatterstar is alive again at Wade's birthday party, but the rest of the team is still gone.

item.name: Gambit
steps: In season 5, Gambit stands with the X-Men to say goodbye as Xavier leaves Earth with Lilandra to be healed.
In episode 5, Gambit dies destroying Master Mold to save Genosha.
In season 2, Apocalypse raises Gambit as a Horseman. Rogue frees him, and he returns to the X-Men.
deceased_step: In episode 5, Gambit dies destroying Master Mold to save Genosha.
next_step: In season 2, Apocalypse raises Gambit as a Horseman. Rogue frees him, and he returns to the X-Men.

item.name: Elektra Natchios
steps: Years earlier, young Elektra's stern father makes her keep afloat in their pool. Later, she finds her mother murdered.
Elektra falls for Matt and fights Daredevil, believing he killed her father, before Bullseye kills her.
Revived by Stick, Elektra becomes an assassin and protects Mark and Abby Miller from the Hand.
In the Void, Elektra fights Cassandra Nova's forces beside Laura, Blade, and Gambit.
deceased_step: Elektra falls for Matt and fights Daredevil, believing he killed her father, before Bullseye kills her.
next_step: Revived by Stick, Elektra becomes an assassin and protects Mark and Abby Miller from the Hand.

item.name: Victor Stein
steps: In episode 8, Jonah treats Victor's brain tumor, but Victor turns violent. When he attacks Chase with the Fistigons, Janet shoots him, and he dies.
In season 2, Janet frees Victor from the stasis Jonah keeps him in, and he helps blow up Jonah's ship. Then Jonah takes over his body.
In episode 9, freed from Jonah's family, Victor learns Janet is gone and joins the fight against Morgan.
deceased_step: In episode 8, Jonah treats Victor's brain tumor, but Victor turns violent. When he attacks Chase with the Fistigons, Janet shoots him, and he dies.
next_step: In season 2, Janet frees Victor from the stasis Jonah keeps him in, and he helps blow up Jonah's ship. Then Jonah takes over his body.

item.name: Phil Coulson
steps: Coulson and Sitwell send Tony Stark to spoil the Council's plan to recruit Emil Blonsky.
Coulson gathers the heroes. When Loki stabs him with the scepter, his death unites the Avengers.
In episode 22, Coulson is back from the dead and leading a new S.H.I.E.L.D. team. When HYDRA rises, Fury makes him Director.
In episode 42, Director Coulson rebuilds S.H.I.E.L.D. in secret and makes peace with the rival 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.'
deceased_step: Coulson gathers the heroes. When Loki stabs him with the scepter, his death unites the Avengers.
next_step: In episode 22, Coulson is back from the dead and leading a new S.H.I.E.L.D. team. When HYDRA rises, Fury makes him Director.

item.name: Dum-E and U
steps: Dum-E helps Tony make Howard's new element and cleans up after. U serves champagne when Tony names Pepper CEO.
Dum-E earns a dunce cap before the Mandarin's attack wrecks Tony's house and both robots. Tony gathers their remains.
Repaired, Dum-E and U help Happy pack the Avengers' gear out of Avengers Tower for the move.
At Happy's condo, Dum-E helps Peter build a LEGO Death Star, and Peter webs Norman Osborn's hand to Dum-E when the Goblin stirs.
deceased_step: Dum-E earns a dunce cap before the Mandarin's attack wrecks Tony's house and both robots. Tony gathers their remains.
next_step: Repaired, Dum-E and U help Happy pack the Avengers' gear out of Avengers Tower for the move.

item.name: Loki
steps: Freed by Korg's rebels, Loki brings the Statesman to Asgard, fights Hela's army so its people can escape, and wakes Surtur to bring down Hela and Asgard.
Loki hands Thanos the Tesseract to save Thor and dies trying to kill him.
In 2012, a captured Loki grabs the Tesseract during the Time Heist and vanishes.
Taken by the TVA, this Loki helps hunt the variant Sylvie, and together they find He Who Remains.
deceased_step: Loki hands Thanos the Tesseract to save Thor and dies trying to kill him.
next_step: In 2012, a captured Loki grabs the Tesseract during the Time Heist and vanishes.

item.name: Vision
steps: Vision sides with Tony, but his blast hits Rhodey by mistake.
Vision hides with Wanda in Scotland until Thanos tears the Mind Stone from his head.
In Westview, the Vision Wanda made fades away, while a rebuilt white Vision regains his memories and flies off.
In episode 2, living in Edinburgh, Vision is hunted by the bounty hunter Paladin and rescues Tommy, who claims to be his son.
deceased_step: Vision hides with Wanda in Scotland until Thanos tears the Mind Stone from his head.
next_step: In Westview, the Vision Wanda made fades away, while a rebuilt white Vision regains his memories and flies off.

item.name: Gamora
steps: Gamora fights Ego with the Guardians and makes peace with Nebula.
Captured by Thanos, Gamora gives up the Soul Stone's location, and he sacrifices her on Vormir.
A Gamora from 2014 turns on her father, fights in the final battle, and slips away.
Now a Ravager, the 2014 Gamora helps save Rocket before rejoining her crew.
deceased_step: Captured by Thanos, Gamora gives up the Soul Stone's location, and he sacrifices her on Vormir.
next_step: A Gamora from 2014 turns on her father, fights in the final battle, and slips away.

item.name: Marc Spector
steps: In episode 4, Gift shop clerk Steven Grant keeps losing time, and learns he shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector. As Khonshu's avatar, Marc races Arthur Harrow to Ammit's tomb, with Layla and Steven at his side.
In episode 5, Shot dead by Harrow, Marc and Steven wake in the Duat and face Marc's guilt over his brother's death.
Marc and Steven return to stop Ammit, and their hidden third identity, Jake Lockley, kills Harrow.
deceased_step: In episode 5, Shot dead by Harrow, Marc and Steven wake in the Duat and face Marc's guilt over his brother's death.
next_step: Marc and Steven return to stop Ammit, and their hidden third identity, Jake Lockley, kills Harrow.

item.name: Natalie Washington
steps: In episode 1, Killed in a drive-by shooting, Natalie lives on as N.A.T.A.L.I.E., the AI Riri builds into her suit.
The AI is lost powering Riri's new suit, but Mephisto's deal brings Natalie back to life.
deceased_step: In episode 1, Killed in a drive-by shooting, Natalie lives on as N.A.T.A.L.I.E., the AI Riri builds into her suit.
next_step: The AI is lost powering Riri's new suit, but Mephisto's deal brings Natalie back to life.

item.name: Elektra Natchios
steps: Elektra pulls Matt into her fight with the Hand and dies saving him from Nobu.
Revived as the Black Sky, Elektra kills Stick and Alexandra, then stays with Matt as Midland Circle collapses.
deceased_step: Elektra pulls Matt into her fight with the Hand and dies saving him from Nobu.
next_step: Revived as the Black Sky, Elektra kills Stick and Alexandra, then stays with Matt as Midland Circle collapses.

item.name: S.H.I.E.L.D.
steps: In episode 13, Coulson's team works S.H.I.E.L.D. cases from the Bus, chasing Centipede and a mystery man called the Clairvoyant.
HYDRA is exposed inside S.H.I.E.L.D., and the agency collapses as Natasha dumps its secrets online.
In episode 22, HYDRA rises from inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and the agency falls. Fury makes Coulson director of what is left.
Fury brings an old S.H.I.E.L.D. helicarrier to Sokovia to carry its people to safety.
deceased_step: HYDRA is exposed inside S.H.I.E.L.D., and the agency collapses as Natasha dumps its secrets online.
next_step: In episode 22, HYDRA rises from inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and the agency falls. Fury makes Coulson director of what is left.

item.name: Genosha
steps: In episode 5, Genosha's mutant council asks Magneto to lead it, and he agrees if Rogue leads with him, as the island joins the UN.
In episode 5, Sentinels attack during the gala and kill thousands of Genosha's mutants.
In episode 16, Xavier rebases the banned X-Men in Genosha's ruins as X-Corp.
deceased_step: In episode 5, Sentinels attack during the gala and kill thousands of Genosha's mutants.
next_step: In episode 16, Xavier rebases the banned X-Men in Genosha's ruins as X-Corp.

item.name: Loki
steps: Loki returns to Asgard with the Sakaar gladiators to help save its people, sets off Ragnarok at Thor's request, and makes peace with Thor aboard the Statesman.
Thanos kills Loki aboard the Asgardian refugee ship.
In 2012, the captured Loki grabs the Tesseract during the Avengers' time heist and escapes.
The TVA catches this escaped Loki, who slowly becomes its ally in the hunt for a dangerous variant.
deceased_step: Thanos kills Loki aboard the Asgardian refugee ship.
next_step: In 2012, the captured Loki grabs the Tesseract during the Avengers' time heist and escapes.

item.name: Agatha Harkness
steps: In episode 8, Agatha agrees to hand Billy over to Death to save herself, and ignores his pleas.
In episode 8, when Death makes Billy and Agatha choose who goes with her, Agatha kisses Rio and dies.
In episode 9, Agatha returns as a ghost and sets out with Billy to find Tommy.
deceased_step: In episode 8, when Death makes Billy and Agatha choose who goes with her, Agatha kisses Rio and dies.
next_step: In episode 9, Agatha returns as a ghost and sets out with Billy to find Tommy.

item.name: Victor Timely
steps: At the 1893 Chicago World's Fair, Victor Timely shows off his inventions as Loki and Mobius watch.
In episode 4, Victor tries to fix the Loom for the TVA, and its radiation tears him apart.
Loki's time slips undo Victor's death. Ouroboros names him co-author of a new TVA handbook.
deceased_step: In episode 4, Victor tries to fix the Loom for the TVA, and its radiation tears him apart.
next_step: Loki's time slips undo Victor's death. Ouroboros names him co-author of a new TVA handbook.

item.name: Nobu
steps: In episode 9, Nobu fights Daredevil for Fisk and dies engulfed in flames.
Alive after all, Nobu leads the Hand in Hell's Kitchen and kills Elektra.
Matt throws Nobu off a rooftop. When he gets back up, Stick cuts off his head.
deceased_step: In episode 9, Nobu fights Daredevil for Fisk and dies engulfed in flames.
next_step: Alive after all, Nobu leads the Hand in Hell's Kitchen and kills Elektra.

item.name: Elektra Natchios
steps: Elektra pulls Matt into her war with the Hand and dies taking Nobu's blade.
In episode 6, Revived by the Hand as the Black Sky, Elektra kills Alexandra and Stick and takes the Hand for herself.
Elektra stays with Matt as Midland Circle collapses on them both.
deceased_step: Elektra pulls Matt into her war with the Hand and dies taking Nobu's blade.
next_step: In episode 6, Revived by the Hand as the Black Sky, Elektra kills Alexandra and Stick and takes the Hand for herself.

item.name: Norman Osborn
steps: Norman Osborn tests a strength serum on himself, goes mad and kills his colleague Dr. Stromm. As the Green Goblin, he kills the Oscorp board at the World Unity Festival in Times Square. He learns Peter is Spider-Man and attacks Aunt May in her home. He drops Mary Jane and a tram full of children from the Queensboro Bridge to test Spider-Man.
His own glider impales him, and he begs Peter not to tell Harry.
Pulled across universes just before his death, Norman loses control to the Goblin again, who fatally wounds Aunt May.
The Spider-Men cure him at the Statue of Liberty, and he is sent home.
deceased_step: His own glider impales him, and he begs Peter not to tell Harry.
next_step: Pulled across universes just before his death, Norman loses control to the Goblin again, who fatally wounds Aunt May.

item.name: Doctor Octopus
steps: Otto Octavius's fusion demo fails, killing his wife Rosie and fusing his AI arms to his spine. Driven by the arms, he robs a bank to rebuild his reactor and takes Aunt May hostage. To get Harry Osborn's tritium, he fights Spider-Man on a train and delivers him to Harry.
Peter talks him down, and Otto sinks his reactor in the river, drowning with it.
Pulled across universes just before he drowns, he fights Peter on a bridge until Stark nanotech takes over his arms.
Doctor Strange locks him in a cell beneath the Sanctum, until Peter frees him and the other visitors to try to cure them.
deceased_step: Peter talks him down, and Otto sinks his reactor in the river, drowning with it.
next_step: Pulled across universes just before he drowns, he fights Peter on a bridge until Stark nanotech takes over his arms.

item.name: Electro
steps: Harry Osborn frees him, and Electro blacks out the city from a power station.
Spider-Man and Gwen overload him, and he explodes.
Pulled across universes just before his death, Max ends up in the Sanctum, determined to keep his power.
He powers up at the Statue of Liberty until Otto helps the Spider-Men cure him.
deceased_step: Spider-Man and Gwen overload him, and he explodes.
next_step: Pulled across universes just before his death, Max ends up in the Sanctum, determined to keep his power.

item.name: Hydro-Man
steps: In episode 16, Morrie Bench becomes Hydro-Man and goes after Mary Jane, his ex-girlfriend.
In episode 16, Mary Jane leads him away from water, and he evaporates.
In episode 59, a clone of Hydro-Man made by Miles Warren returns and kidnaps Mary Jane.
In episode 60, like the Mary Jane clone, the unstable Hydro-Man clone breaks down and dies.
deceased_step: In episode 16, Mary Jane leads him away from water, and he evaporates.
next_step: In episode 59, a clone of Hydro-Man made by Miles Warren returns and kidnaps Mary Jane.

item.name: Lady Deathstrike
steps: Under Stryker's control, Yuriko serves as his silent enforcer at Alkali Lake.
Wolverine kills her by flooding her body with liquid adamantium.
A Lady Deathstrike variant fights for Cassandra Nova in the Void and is beaten in the resistance's raid on her lair.
deceased_step: Wolverine kills her by flooding her body with liquid adamantium.
next_step: A Lady Deathstrike variant fights for Cassandra Nova in the Void and is beaten in the resistance's raid on her lair.

item.name: Jean Grey
steps: Jean returns from Alkali Lake as the Phoenix and destroys Charles Xavier. She sides with Magneto and tears Alcatraz apart in a rage.
Wolverine kills her to stop the destruction.
In the new 2023 that Logan wakes to, Jean is alive and well at the school.
deceased_step: Wolverine kills her to stop the destruction.
next_step: In the new 2023 that Logan wakes to, Jean is alive and well at the school.

item.name: Wade Wilson
steps: Stryker turns Wade Wilson, a Team X mercenary, into Weapon XI, loaded with stolen mutant powers.
Logan and Victor defeat him, and Logan cuts off his head.
Later, his severed head opens its eyes.
Deadpool travels back in time and shoots Weapon XI dead.
deceased_step: Logan and Victor defeat him, and Logan cuts off his head.
next_step: Later, his severed head opens its eyes.

item.name: Strange Supreme
steps: In episode 18, he captures heroes and villains from many worlds to feed to the Forge and rebuild his lost universe.
In episode 18, Captain Carter frees him from his inner demon, and he sacrifices himself to the Forge.
In season 3, now the living soul of his restored universe, Strange strips the Eminence and two other Watchers of their power.
deceased_step: In episode 18, Captain Carter frees him from his inner demon, and he sacrifices himself to the Forge.
next_step: In season 3, now the living soul of his restored universe, Strange strips the Eminence and two other Watchers of their power.

item.name: HYDRA
steps: Zemo digs up HYDRA's 1991 mission that killed the Starks and kills its last frozen super soldiers in Siberia.
In episode 66, Hive takes over HYDRA's faithful, and Talbot's ATCU dismantles the rest. Hive later dies in space.
In episode 76, ex-HYDRA agents hired by the Watchdogs ambush Director Mace's team after their Quinjet goes down.
In episode 103, General Hale secretly serves HYDRA and raises her daughter Ruby to be its next leader.
deceased_step: In episode 66, Hive takes over HYDRA's faithful, and Talbot's ATCU dismantles the rest. Hive later dies in space.
next_step: In episode 76, ex-HYDRA agents hired by the Watchdogs ambush Director Mace's team after their Quinjet goes down.

item.name: HYDRA
steps: In episode 103, General Hale secretly serves HYDRA and raises her daughter Ruby to be its next leader.
In episode 108, the deaths of Ruby, Strucker and Hale bring Hale's HYDRA to an end.
In episode 128, S.H.I.E.L.D. must keep HYDRA's past intact, as the Chronicoms help Freddy Malick push its plans ahead.
Bucky makes amends for the killings HYDRA forced on him. Zemo kills Nagel, a scientist from HYDRA's super soldier program.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
deceased_step: In episode 108, the deaths of Ruby, Strucker and Hale bring Hale's HYDRA to an end.

item.name: The Four Horsemen
steps: In ancient Egypt, En Sabah Nur's Four Horsemen watch as crowds chant his name and he raises pyramids.
In 3600 BC, traitors entomb En Sabah Nur, and his four Horsemen die defending him.
In 1983, the reawakened En Sabah Nur empowers Storm, Psylocke, Angel and Magneto as new Horsemen, and they kidnap Xavier.
Angel dies in a crash, Psylocke flees, and Storm and Magneto turn on Apocalypse.
deceased_step: In 3600 BC, traitors entomb En Sabah Nur, and his four Horsemen die defending him.
